checklist.detail: First tangential mode ~643 Hz is in the band damaging instability lives in (<4000 Hz) and the injector is soft (dP/Pc 0.17 < 0.18). Historically this regime needed an odd-compartment injector-face baffle or corner-mounted Helmholtz cavities. Stiffen the injector, or plan on damping devices.
checklist.name: Combustion acoustic-mode margin

checklist.detail: OK - primary hoop stress ~101 MPa (~8.5 MPa net jacket-vs-gas differential, Huzel eq 4-27/4-28, tube_wall) vs a ~133 MPa allowable at the end of active cooling (area ratio ~10.0) (Inconel 718 Nickel Superalloy, SF 1.5, wall ~0.57 mm). The thermal-restraint stress (~380 MPa at the throat, dT = q*t/k across the wall) is a self-limiting secondary stress, not a burst load: with the hoop load it exceeds Inconel 718 Nickel Superalloy's ~200 MPa hot yield, so the hot face yields a little each firing - expected for a regen tube wall (the real F-1/J-2/RL10 do the same in this model). Its life limit is the 'Throat thermal-fatigue cycle life' row.
